hook: 'Date spots in Nairobi under {price} for 2' in a white box with the name of the bar under it

lesson: A split screen of a known local meme above a product card with price and number is how small Kigali sellers borrow attention; keep it as an option, but mind copyright of the clip.

hook: Reply to a comment 'You can buy them from Amazon' while she opens a pink packaging box with a melting-smile logo

hook: Mannequins in yellow and lime kaftans at a shop door (title: good made-in-Rwanda clothes are at Urugero Fashion)

hook: Wide low-angle shot of a new double-storey house with a sliding gate; phone number {phone} in the title
first3s: Gimbal push towards the gate and facade of a new house, grey stone panel and arched window.
